bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 71
(cd "$root/scripts" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B userbot_test_client.py bug_report_inbox_check) || exit 72
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$db" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 73
result="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_bug_reports WHERE body LIKE 'IPC_BUG_REPORT_E2E_%' AND state='delivered';")" || exit 74
test "$result" -ge 1 || exit 75
userbot="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_bug_report_userbot_delivery d JOIN gaybbs_bug_reports r ON r.id=d.report_id WHERE r.body LIKE 'IPC_BUG_REPORT_E2E_%' AND d.state='delivered';")" || exit 76
test "$userbot" -ge 1 || exit 77
echo REPORT_DUAL_DELIVERY_DB_AND_USERBOT_INBOX_PASS
